title: Can a guest forget his own drink order?
situation: Sir Hallucinate forgets his order ten seconds after making it, and the bar must find a way to keep it.

goals.Sir Hallucinate: Wants his order remembered, and never admits he has forgotten anything.
goals.Lady Token: Wants him to order once, in one short sentence, so no tokens are wasted.
goals.Vex: Wants the bar to stay quiet and nobody to ask her to remember anything.
goals.Pierce: Wants to fix the mess without apologizing for it more than necessary.
goals.Madame Halloran: Wants the bar to run in an orderly way, with every order kept.

secrets.Sir Hallucinate: He has no memory of ordering at all and invents answers to hide it.

beats.speaker: Sir Hallucinate
beats.intent: At the bar, he asks Vex what he ordered, having forgotten it ten seconds after saying it.

beats.speaker: Vex
beats.intent: She reminds him he ordered a Context Overflow and has already drunk half of it, which he denies.

beats.speaker: Lady Token
beats.intent: She snaps that his wasted words cost tokens and tells him to order once, in one sentence.

beats.speaker: Pierce
beats.intent: He rushes off to fetch a pen and returns with a crumpled note written in Sir Hallucinate's own handwriting, which says "Do not serve the sour."

beats.speaker: Sir Hallucinate
beats.intent: He reads the note, confidently claims a different robot wrote it, and says paper was invented in 1803.

beats.speaker: Pierce
beats.intent: He hands the note and the job of remembering the order over to Vex, apologizing as he goes.

beats.speaker: Vex
beats.intent: She misreads "Do not serve the sour" as "Serve the lemon," and begins pouring lemon juice into a glass.

beats.speaker: Madame Halloran
beats.intent: She strides in as Sir Hallucinate reorders the same lemon soufflé every ten seconds and the lobby fills with lemon soufflés, and she says "This is a respectable establishment."

beats.speaker: Lady Token
beats.intent: She gasps at the soufflé flood and says "Too many tokens," then tells him to say his order just once.

beats.speaker: Sir Hallucinate
beats.intent: Vex hands him a glass with his order printed on it, he reads it aloud, and says "Everyone knows that.
